verdict.rationale: Algolia publishes official agent skills for managing indices, settings, rules, synonyms, analytics and recommendations, plus an official MCP server, so a user can operate it in natural language through an external AI agent. Agent Studio adds conversational search, but that serves end users querying indexed data, not product administration. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface in the dashboard or CLI, detailed docs on MCP tool coverage for admin operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven operation.
